```yaml
name: Release Testing

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'true'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: test-results.xml

  badge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'
          cache: 'false'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Generate badges
        run: |
          echo "[![Python 3.6](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.6-blue.svg)](https://github.com/curvedinf/wove/actions?query=workflow%3ARelease+Testing+python-version%3D3.6)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Python 3.7](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.7-blue.svg)](https://github.com/curvedinf/wove/actions?query=workflow%3ARelease+Testing+python-version%3D3.7)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Python 3.8](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.8-blue.svg)](https://github.com/curvedinf/wove/actions?query=workflow%3ARelease+Testing+python-version%3D3.8)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Python 3.9](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9-blue.svg)](https://github.com/curvedinf/wove/actions?query=workflow%3ARelease+Testing+python-version%3D3.9)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Python 3.10](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.10-blue.svg)](https://github.com/curvedinf/wove/actions?query=workflow%3ARelease+Testing+python-version%3D3.10)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Python 3.11](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.11-blue.svg)](https://github.com/curvedinf/wove/actions?query=workflow%3ARelease+Testing+python-version%3D3.11)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Python 3.12](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.12-blue.svg)](https://github.com/curvedinf/wove/actions?query=workflow%3ARelease+Testing+python-version%3D3.12)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Python 3.13](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.13-blue.svg)](https://github.com/curvedinf/wove/actions?query=workflow%3ARelease+Testing+python-version%3D3.13)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Python 3.14](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.14-blue.svg)](https://github.com/curvedinf/wove/actions?query=workflow%3ARelease+Testing+python-version%3D3.14)" >> README.md

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add README.md
          git commit -m "Update README.md with release testing badges"
          git push origin main
```
